name: 82930 · Evanston, WY
findings: ZIP 82930 (Evanston) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82930 (Evanston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 82930 (Evanston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
